name: Hinge Pin Removal
description: On outward-opening doors where hinge pins are accessible from the exterior, removing the pins allows the door to be swung open from the hinge side regardless of lock state. This is an effective bypass on many exterior doors in older commercial and institutional buildings where hinges were not designed with security in mind. The CI hammerless hinge pin tool allows pin removal without striking tools that would create noise or visible damage.

blue.det: Audible hammering during attack; hinge pins missing post-incident; camera coverage of hinge side.
blue.cm: Security hinges with non-removable pins or set screws; hinge bolts (security studs); outward-opening doors avoided on high-security areas.
